answer: Each agent identity is registered against an attested MRENCLAVE measurement, which identifies approved enclave code; platform attestation and a hardware-bound key establish that it runs on genuine SGX- or SEV-capable silicon. Copying a velvet- or quartz-named VM can duplicate software state, but not forge the key or attestation. Additional valid identities therefore require access to additional attested hardware capacity, rather than simple VM cloning; the kernel alone cannot confer trust.
